neighbours.label: a modifier opening a named health or social harm: 'high' before blood pressure or cholesterol, 'childhood' before obesity or mortality, 'lower' before emissions
fire: Her doctor treats asthma, gout and high blood pressure at the clinic.
Poor diet raises the risk of high cholesterol and heart disease.
Men with obesity or high triglycerides should see a specialist.
The vaccine campaign lowered childhood mortality in the province.
Schools started new lunches to fight childhood obesity nationwide.
Smoking, stress and high blood sugar all harm the arteries.
The new filters help reduce pollution and lower emissions from the plant.
Regular exercise can prevent high blood pressure in older adults.
quiet: Her doctor works in a tall building with a high ceiling.
Poor weather closed the high road through the mountains.
Men with ladders should reach the high shelves at the back.

Schools collected old photos to share childhood memories nationwide.
Smoking is banned on the high balcony of the hotel.
The new filters sit in a box on the floor of the plant.
Regular visitors can see her childhood home in the old town.

notes: Near misses keep 'high' and 'childhood' but aim them at harmless nouns.
